binding.chain: eip155:11155111 (Sepolia testnet — mainnet requires a separate, explicitly recorded decision)
binding.purpose: Binds the ERC-8004 on-chain identity below to the VLUE r1 ledger operator. Any transaction from this address that is not an attestation of a settled entry on this ledger is unauthorized (one-way valve: outbound attestations only; chain state is never an input to this ledger).

note: sig covers canonical(binding) — sorted keys, compact separators
